title: Family joining later
summary: You landed first on an EP — spouse and kids follow weeks or months later. Sequence Dependant Pass IPAs, Arrival Cards, school seats, and day-one Singpass/bank steps so the join-up week is not improvised.

sections.title: Apply for each Dependant Pass on its own clock
sections.body: MOM lets employers apply for Dependant Passes with the main EP or later. Each family member is a separate application. Bring them in only after approval — MOM will not extend a short-term visit pass that expires before DP issuance. Babies born here get a short ICA Special Pass window to file.
bullets: Submit one DP application per spouse / child — do not batch names on one form
Most EP/S Pass dependant outcomes: within about 3 weeks; PEP/EntrePass lines can take longer
Fees: application + issuance (plus Multiple Journey Visa if required) — confirm live MOM schedule
Align IPA validity with their flight, not only your own arrival story

sections.title: Watch the IPA enter-and-issue window
sections.body: An EP IPA is a pre-approved single-entry permission: the candidate generally has six months to enter Singapore and get the pass issued. Dependant IPAs follow the same issuance discipline once approved. Sketch the deadline with the IPA window tool before you book non-refundable flights.
bullets: Print / save both employer and pass-holder IPA copies
Issue the pass in EP eService after they land (medical if the IPA requires it)
Notification letter after issuance is typically valid for one month while the card prints
Need more time? Employer can request IPA extension ≥2 weeks before expiry

sections.title: Join-up week: Arrival Card, SIM, Singpass, bank
sections.body: Each dependant still needs their own SG Arrival Card inside the three-day window. A Singapore mobile number unlocks Singpass SMS 2FA; the physical DP / FIN makes bank KYC far less painful. Do not assume your EP card in your wallet clears their onboarding.
bullets: Each traveller submits SG Arrival Card within three days before landing
Prepaid +65 SIM on passport at Changi if postpaid still wants a pass card
Register Singpass once FIN is live — Face Verify when offered
Bank pack: passport, DP/IPA, proof of address (tenancy or employer letter)

sections.title: Housing and address proof before they fly
sections.body: A spare bedroom or a serviced week beats a last-minute Airbnb scramble. Banks and schools want a Singapore address that matches the application. If the lease is only in your name, bring relationship proof for joint account or kids’ school forms.
bullets: Confirm pet / guest / occupancy clauses if the condo is picky
Hold a week of serviced apartment as buffer if renovation or check-in slips
Update MOM / ICA contact address once they have a stable bed

sections.title: School seats move on MOE and IS clocks
sections.body: Valid DP holders can study full-time without a separate Student’s Pass, but seats and fees do not wait for your family flight. International-school waitlists and AEIS/S-AEIS windows are calendar problems — see /calendar. Government-school international-student fees apply even when you pay Singapore tax.
bullets: Hold offers with written start dates that survive DP IPA delays
AEIS tests are only held in Singapore — plan who sits them and when
Collect vaccination and prior-school transcripts before the suitcase closes

sections.title: Hand off to arriving day-7 / day-30 lists
sections.body: Once they clear immigration, stop inventing a parallel checklist. Reuse the arriving boards for SIM, SGWorkPass (main pass), GP, and PayNow — then return here only for DP-specific renewals and LOC questions.
bullets: Open /journeys/arriving/day-7 after hotel Wi-Fi works
Calendar DP / main EP expiry together — they often move as a set
If the main EP ever cancels, dependants fall with it — see /journeys/between-jobs
